rules.statement: A Magistrate cannot assume jurisdiction to hear and determine a case under Section 66 of the Primary Courts' Procedure Act if a civil action is pending in a District Court, unless there is a breach of peace.
rules.supporting_quote: If the mere institution of a suit in a civil Court is sufficient to divest the Magistrate of his jurisdiction, the whole purpose of Section 62 will be defeated. A scheming party will be enabled to play hide and seek
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 62 of the Administration of Justice Law
